description: The library suspects recurring problems with loaned devices and wants to see whether damage patterns link to certain models, accessories, checkout lengths, or return conditions.

user_profile.persona: 33-year-old technology services librarian responsible for a device lending collection
user_profile.context: Individual incidents seem manageable, but taken together they may reveal a preventable pattern
user_profile.communication_style: Pattern-seeking and practical, wants incidents compared without jumping to blame

fact_sheet.fact: The library owns 15 'Innovatech Tablet Pro 11' devices, purchased on May 10, 2022.
The library owns 10 'ConnectaLink 5G Hotspot' devices, model CL-H5G-21.
The library owns 20 'ZenithBook Air 13' laptops, purchased on January 15, 2023.
The 'Innovatech Tablet Pro 11' with serial number ITP11-A007 is part of the lending collection.
All lendable devices are stored and charged in secure cabinet #3 behind the Technology Services Desk.
The Technology Services Librarian responsible for the device collection is named Alex Chen.
The standard loan period for all devices is 21 days.
A single 7-day renewal is permitted for devices if there are no active holds.
Patrons must sign the 'Device Lending Agreement Form 7B' at each checkout.
On October 26, 2023, 'Innovatech Tablet Pro 11' (SN: ITP11-A007) was returned with a cracked screen.
The damage report for the cracked screen on ITP11-A007 is filed under incident number D2023-10-26-01.
On November 5, 2023, 'ZenithBook Air 13' (SN: ZBA13-C012) was returned with a non-functional 'E' key.
The patron who returned ITP11-A007 (incident D2023-10-26-01) had the device checked out for the full 21-day period.
The patron who returned ZBA13-C012 reported that the device was in a backpack that got wet in the rain.
Three separate 'Innovatech Tablet Pro 11' devices were returned with charging port damage between August 1 and October 31, 2023.
Incident report D2023-09-15-03 notes that 'Innovatech Tablet Pro 11' (SN: ITP11-A011) was returned with its stylus missing.
A 'ConnectaLink 5G Hotspot' (SN: CLH5G-18) was reported lost by a patron on September 1, 2023.
Each 'Innovatech Tablet Pro 11' is loaned with a 'DuraShell Folio Case' and a 'Precision Stylus'.
Each 'ZenithBook Air 13' is loaned with a 'PowerBlock 65W USB-C Charger' and a padded neoprene sleeve.
The 'DuraShell Folio Case' for tablet ITP11-A007 was returned with a broken corner clasp on October 26, 2023.
The library's inventory shows a stock of 5 replacement 'Precision Stylus' units.
Staff report device damage using the 'Tech Incident' form on the library's intranet, located at http://intranet.mpl.lib/forms/tech-incident.
Alex Chen reviews all new 'Tech Incident' reports every Monday at 10:00 AM.
Damaged devices are sent to 'GadgetFix Repair' at 123 Tech Way, Maplewood for assessment and quotes.
The library's assessed replacement cost for an 'Innovatech Tablet Pro 11' is $450.
The repair quote from GadgetFix Repair for the cracked screen on ITP11-A007 was $125.
The daily overdue fine for a lendable device is $5.00, capped at the device's replacement cost.

user_needs.description: How many 'Innovatech Tablet Pro 11' devices were returned with charging port damage between August 1 and October 31, 2023?
What specific damage was reported for 'Innovatech Tablet Pro 11' with serial number ITP11-A007 on October 26, 2023?
user_needs.prediction_reason: After identifying a pattern of damage for a specific model, the user would naturally drill down into a concrete recent example of damage for that same model.

user_needs.description: What is the incident number for the cracked screen on ITP11-A007?
user_needs.prediction_reason: This is a direct follow-up to retrieve the reference number for the specific incident being investigated.

user_needs.description: For how long was the device ITP11-A007 checked out before the cracked screen was reported?
user_needs.prediction_reason: When investigating a damage incident, understanding the duration of the loan is a key factor in determining potential causes or patterns.

user_needs.description: What accessories are loaned with each 'Innovatech Tablet Pro 11'?
user_needs.prediction_reason: After learning about damage to the main device, it's logical to inquire about the included accessories to see if they were involved or also damaged.

user_needs.description: What damage was reported to the case for tablet ITP11-A007 when it was returned on October 26, 2023?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After learning that the tablet comes with a case, the immediate next question is whether that specific case was also damaged in the incident.

user_needs.description: What was the repair quote for the cracked screen on ITP11-A007?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: Once the specific damage to a device is known, the next logical step in a practical investigation is to determine the financial cost of the repair.

user_needs.description: What is the library's assessed replacement cost for an 'Innovatech Tablet Pro 11'?
user_needs.prediction_reason: After finding out the repair cost, the user would want to compare it against the full replacement cost to assess the financial severity of the damage.

user_needs.description: What was the issue reported for 'Innovatech Tablet Pro 11' (SN: ITP11-A011) in incident report D2023-09-15-03?
Is a 'Precision Stylus' one of the standard accessories included with each Innovatech Tablet Pro 11 checkout?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After seeing that a specific tablet incident involved a missing stylus, a direct follow-up is whether a Precision Stylus is normally included with each checkout of that model.

user_needs.description: What damage was reported for 'ZenithBook Air 13' (SN: ZBA13-C012) on November 5, 2023?
What did the patron report as the cause of the damage to the ZenithBook Air 13 (ZBA13-C012)?
user_needs.prediction_reason: After identifying damage to a different device model, the user would want to know the reported circumstances to see if it's a different kind of problem.

user_needs.description: What is the standard loan period for all devices?
Is a renewal permitted for devices and if so, for how long?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After confirming the standard loan period, a natural follow-up question is about the policy for extending that period through renewal.

user_needs.description: What form must patrons sign at device checkout?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After hearing a patron's explanation for damage, the librarian might want to review the agreement that outlines patron responsibility, which is signed at checkout.
